# Lab 21.8: Slot Estimator & Commitments

## What We Are Going to Do
Use the slot estimator to model how many slots your workload needs, and learn how capacity commitments work, without buying one.

## Steps

1. **[Console] Open the slot estimator.** **Workload management → Slot estimator**. It shows your slot usage over the last 30 days and the job performance you would get at different slot levels.

2. **[Console] Model a change.** Move the slider to 100, 200 and 500 slots. Read how the percentage of jobs that would slow down changes.

3. **[SQL] Check the peaks yourself.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT
  APPROX_QUANTILES(slots, 100)[OFFSET(50)] AS p50_slots,
  APPROX_QUANTILES(slots, 100)[OFFSET(95)] AS p95_slots,
  MAX(slots) AS max_slots
FROM (
  SELECT period_start, SUM(period_slot_ms) / 1000 AS slots
  FROM `region-us`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.JOBS_TIMELINE_BY_PROJECT
  WHERE job_creation_time &gt; TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
  GROUP BY period_start
);</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   A common pattern: baseline near p50 and autoscale up to p95.

4. **[CLI] What a commitment looks like.** **Do not run this** unless you mean to buy. A 1-year commitment of 100 Enterprise slots:

<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">

<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;"># bq mk --capacity_commitment --location=US --edition=ENTERPRISE --plan=ANNUAL --slots=100
bq ls --capacity_commitment --location=US</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Commitments give a lower price per slot-hour but are billed for the whole term.

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Slot estimator | Performance at different sizes |
| p50 / p95 | Baseline and autoscale guide |
| Commitments | 1- or 3-year discount |
| This lab | No purchase |
